prompt:
Process pending manual add-by-address requests for 所有者的 VPS rating card (the payload lists them; each has an id and a typed address query). This replicates exactly the workflow 所有者 uses in chat when he gives Muse an address: check the card first, verify the current listing on REW, add as 新增 only when verified.

VPS access: SSH <SSH_USER>@<VPS_IP> port 22122, key ~/.ssh/<部署私钥>, known-hosts file ~/.ssh/known_hosts_vps, with proxy env vars stripped (env -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy). Data files on the VPS: ~/rating-card-vps/houses.json (the card, sole data source) and ~/rating-card-vps/add-requests.json (the queue). Never write any password anywhere; the web login is not used.

For each request still in status 待核实 (re-read add-requests.json on the VPS first; skip ones already processed):
1. Duplicate check against houses.json: normalized address match (street number + all typed tokens in the house's address/city/postal) or an MLS number typed in the query matching a house MLS. If duplicate: set the request status to 已有, houseId to that house's id, note '卡上已有', and do not add anything.
2. Otherwise verify the CURRENT for-sale listing on REW (rew.ca) for that exact address, using the browser: price, beds/baths, sqft, MLS, REW property type, Year Built, postal code, city, cover photo URL, listing page URL, the monthly strata fee (the REW page's "Strata Maintenance Fees" row), the parking spaces and parking details, and — only when the page or its Building Information explicitly names a developer/builder company — the builder name must all come from that unit's own current REW listing. Never use a neighbouring unit, an old/sold listing, or another source as a substitute. If there is no current REW listing for it, set the request status to 查不到 and note 'REW 无现挂牌' (or the concrete reason), and add nothing.
3. If verified: before changing anything, back up houses.json on the VPS (cp houses.json houses.json.bak-<date>-add). Download the REW cover photo, verify it is a real JPEG, and put it at VPS ~/rating-card-vps/public/photos/house-<newId>.jpg. Use the geo coordinates from the REW listing page when shown; otherwise geocode with the BC Geocoder from the full civic address (street number + street + city) and accept only a high-score match at civic-number precision, cross-checked against the postal code (the point must land near that postal code and cluster with the same community's other houses). A street-name-only match is never acceptable (it once put 5350 Manor Street 2.6 km away on a same-name segment); if no civic-level point verifies, leave lat/lon null rather than guessing. Append the house with: next id (max id + 1), sortOrder = id, address in the card's format (unit + street, e.g. '9 181 Ravine Drive'), city, postalCode, community = street name + abbreviated type as used in existing data (e.g. 'Ravine Dr'), label = '<unit> 号' when the address has a unit prefix else null, price, sqft, beds, baths, mls, strataFee = the verified monthly Strata Maintenance Fees number from the REW page (if the verified page has no such row, or the listing text states no strata fees, use 0), parking = '<spaces> · <details>' built from the REW page's Parking Spaces and Parking Details (spaces only if no details, details only if no spaces, null if the page shows no parking information), builder = the developer/builder company name exactly as printed when the page explicitly names one, otherwise null (never substitute the complex/building name), status 新增, viewed false, rating null, exclusionReason null, poorEnv false, photoUrl /photos/house-<newId>.jpg, photoLabel 挂牌照片, listingUrl = the REW page, propertyType = 双拼 for REW Duplex, Townhouse for REW Townhouse, otherwise the REW type as shown, builtYear from REW or null, lat/lon, note '所有者 卡上手动添加'. Set the request status to 已添加 with houseId = new id.
4. After any change: validate houses.json and add-requests.json parse as JSON on the VPS and confirm `systemctl is-active rating-card` (do not verify with unauthenticated curl to /api/houses; a 401 there is the password gate working).
5. Report the outcome for every processed request to the chat: added (id, address, price, MLS, type, built year, strata fee) / already existed (id) / not found. If an added house crosses 所有者的 age line for its type, flag that explicitly in the report — Townhouse: built before 2015; 双拼 / 独栋: built before 2000 (the TH threshold moved from 2000 to 2015 on 2026-11-04; 所有者 set 独栋 back to the 2000 line on 2026-11-05, and 双拼 likewise later that day) — but still add it as 新增, because the manual-add flow he specified adds verified houses as 新增 and leaves the screening decision to him.

Do not touch any other house's decision fields, and do not use an old local copy of houses.json to overwrite the VPS file; always start from the VPS's current file.
